# Central Texas Lawn Leveling

> Central Texas Lawn Leveling (CTXLL) levels, topdresses and core-aerates residential lawns across Central Texas, from Kyle and Buda up to Georgetown and Salado. Based in Georgetown, TX. Phone (512) 516-5749. Website https://centraltexaslawnleveling.com.

## Key facts
- Services: lawn leveling (lawn smoothing), compost topdressing, core aeration, soil testing and lawn care consulting, tree trimming for trees up to 18 feet, DIY mix delivery.
- Minimums: lawn leveling $1,800 minimum; core aeration starts at $100 (location and yard size); compost topdressing $750 minimum. Price depends on area, lawn size, material and depth, location and access. Quotes are free and can usually be estimated over the phone.
- Season: most services are done during the active growing season. Spring + fall topdressing program runs about February through October. Leveling generally mid-March through October around Austin.
- Aeration: how often depends on compaction, at least once a year, anytime February through October.
- Blends: 80/20 soil health blend (80% compost, 20% sand, topdressing only); 50/50 (50% compost, 50% sand, a heavier topdressing that helps with some dips while adding compost; still topdressing, not leveling); leveling blend (80% sand, 20% compost) for newer yards' first two levelings, then straight sand. Manure-based compost, no bio-solids, screened, with coffee grounds.
- Depths: topdressing 1/8" to 1/3" (up to about 1 cubic yard per 1,000 sq ft); leveling about 1/2" (about 1.5 yd³ per 1,000 sq ft) to 2/3" (about 2 yd³).
- Leveling and topdressing are separate services; leveling uses the 80% sand blend.
- Rules: will topdress any lawn including St. Augustine and shade; does not level shaded yards; new sod can be leveled once established (as soon as about 45 days).
- Median organic matter in their Central Texas soil tests: 2.71%; target 4–5%.
- LCRA rebate: still running; up to $1,200 for homeowners and up to $5,000 for commercial properties such as city parks, soccer fields and sports fields. Details: https://www.lcra.org/water/watersmart/rebates/
- DIY mix: 80/20 leveling mix $100/yard, masonry sand $54/yard, plus tax and delivery, 4 to 24 yards.
- Service area: Georgetown, Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander, Liberty Hill, Pflugerville, Manor, Kyle, Buda, Dripping Springs, Salado.
- Commercial, HOA, multifamily and estate grounds maintenance and landscaping: sister company Central Texas Landscaping, https://centraltexaslandscaping.net/
